headline: Six Fronts Surge as Base Turnover Spikes
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the pace of strategic‑base exchanges has sharpened on the busiest sectors. Weathered Expanse still leads with 44 ownership changes in the past day, colonial losses climbing to 9,844 and Warden losses to 15,862 while fresh enlistments reach 521. Fishermans Row has surged to 48 flips, its casualties now at 596 colonial and 648 Warden dead with 301 new enlistees. Stlican Shelf records 41 changes, adding 3,086 colonial and 2,976 Warden casualties and 381 enlistments. Callahans Passage remains the bloodiest theatre, logging 32 flips, 11,719 colonial and 13,739 Warden dead and 748 enlistments. Nevish Line and Mooring County each report nine and six flips respectively, Nevish adding 5,540 colonial and 5,200 Warden casualties with 595 enlistments, Mooring adding 4,068 colonial and 4,452 Warden dead with 593 enlistments. A handful of quieter regions — Godcrofts, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Palantine Berm and Stema Landing — have recorded only a few changes, while the majority of sectors show no base activity at all.
